Title: General availability: Azure SDK for Go

Body.Content:
This new SDK allows developers to build applications that can perform management actions on Azure resources using the resource manager library and interact with Azure services like Identity, Key Vault, Tables, and Service Bus using their respective service libraries. The SDK has been modernized to follow the Azure SDK guidelines and be idiomatic for Go. Additionally, it introduces a number of updates and new features.

Learn more.
